title: Integration & Order Management CRs
summary: New Order Management and Integration functionalities enabling BSS–OSS communication, built on Oracle SOA Suite 12c, Oracle OSM, WebLogic Integration (WLI) and Java EE.
description: A recurring yearly programme of change requests for OTE, delivered by Cognity (programmes 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026). It implements new functionalities in the Order Management and Integration systems to enable communication between BSS and OSS systems.
The functionality spans Order Management, Customer Management, Trouble Ticketing, Work Force Management, SAP, Collection and other areas.
The system is built on Oracle SOA Suite 12c, Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM), WebLogic Integration (WLI) and Java EE.
